event.title: "Software freedom in the age of AI" talk at Plone Conference in Maastricht in Maastricht, Netherlands

body.p: On Friday the 25th of September at 09:45 Matthias Kirschner give a talk about "Software freedom in the age of AI" at Plone Conference in Maastricht, Netherlands. Plone Conference is the annual global event of the Plone Foundation — the non-profit steward of the Plone open-source content management system.
The talk will be in English and it will take place at 09:45 on the room "de Apostelhoeve".
